waypoints.name: SR-20 turnout below Le Petit Cheval (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Climbers' trail starts at the far west end of the Milepost 165 pullout, crosses Early Winters Creek, then traverses an avalanche path (three fixed-rope sections) toward the base of the formation; ~1.5hr approach. A faster alternative uses the gully paralleling Spontaneity Arete.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the milepost 165 pullout below Le Petit Cheval, roughly 2 miles east of Washington Pass. Park toward the far west end of the pullout — that is where the climbers' trail starts, dropping steeply toward the Early Winters Creek crossing. The pullout is the trailhead; there is no spur road and the trail itself is unmarked apart from occasional cairns.
